Figure 2: Overall architecture of the MA-DAR plugin. Operating as a plug-and-play extension, MA-DAR establishes dual data interfaces to ingest external current temporal features and replayed historical representations. These heterogeneous context representations are sequentially aligned and routed within the plugin through Manifold Alignment, Dynamic Gating, and a Polarization Penalty.
